title: Durga Puja
summary: Durga Puja is Bengal's biggest festival, celebrating goddess Durga's victory over Mahishasura. It's marked by pandals, idols, pandal-hopping, food, new clothes, dhunuchi dance and sindoor khela on Bijoya Dashami. UNESCO recognised Kolkata's Durga Puja as intangible cultural heritage in 2021.
